intro: Every entry says what kind of record it is, where it stands today, and where the number comes from. A world record is something no one else has done; an India record is the best by an Indian; a personal best is his own high-water mark.

official.note: Headline career figures used across the site. Format-level figures are from ESPNcricinfo's player records; the aggregate line is the ICC Hall of Fame citation.

international.source: ICC Hall of Fame citation (538 / 17,266); ESPNcricinfo (dismissals, captaincy)

records.title: Only captain to win all three ICC men's white-ball trophies
records.value: 2007 World T20 · 2011 World Cup · 2013 Champions Trophy
records.context: Johannesburg 24 Sep 2007; Mumbai 2 Apr 2011; Birmingham 23 Jun 2013.

records.title: Most international matches as captain
records.context: 60 Tests, 200 ODIs, 72 T20Is between 2007 and 2017. Ricky Ponting captained Australia 324 times.

records.title: Most stumpings in international cricket
records.context: 38 in Tests, 123 in ODIs, 34 in T20Is. Kumar Sangakkara is next with 139.

records.title: Most stumpings in ODIs
records.context: Sangakkara made 99. Recognised by Guinness World Records.

records.title: Most stumpings in T20Is
records.context: He still held the record at his retirement in 2020; the mark has since been approached by keepers with far more T20Is.

records.title: Highest ODI score by a wicketkeeper
records.context: v Sri Lanka, Jaipur, 31 Oct 2005, off 145 balls, chasing 299. Also the highest score in an ODI run-chase at the time.

records.title: Most not-outs in ODIs
records.context: From 297 innings. Shaun Pollock (72) and Chaminda Vaas (72) are next. It is why an average of 50.57 sits on a strike rate of 87.

records.title: Most ODI wins as captain for India
records.context: 110 wins, 74 losses, 5 ties, 11 no results from 200 ODIs. Only Ricky Ponting (165) has more wins in all.

records.title: Most ODIs as captain
records.context: Ponting captained 230 ODIs; Dhoni's 200 is the most for India, ahead of Azharuddin (174).

records.title: Most Test wins as India captain
records.context: 27 wins, 18 losses, 15 draws in 60 Tests, 2008–2014. Surpassed by Virat Kohli (40) in 2019.

records.title: First Indian captain to take India to No.1 in the ICC Test rankings
records.context: After beating Sri Lanka 2–0 at home. India held the ranking for 20 months.

records.title: Highest Test score by an Indian wicketkeeper
records.context: v Australia, Chennai, Feb 2013, off 265 balls. Also the highest score by an Indian Test captain at the time (Kohli 235 in 2016 and 254* in 2019 have since passed it); Rishabh Pant has not passed 224 either.

records.title: Fastest Indian to the No.1 ODI batting ranking
records.context: First Indian to top the ICC ODI batting rankings, 16 months after debut.

records.title: First wicketkeeper to 10,000 ODI runs for India
records.context: Reached at Lord's, 14 July 2018. Fourth Indian overall to the mark; the only one with an average above 50.

records.title: Most international dismissals by an Indian wicketkeeper
records.context: 634 catches and 195 stumpings. Third in the world behind Mark Boucher (998) and Adam Gilchrist (905).

records.title: Most IPL titles as captain
records.context: Rohit Sharma also has five with Mumbai Indians. Dhoni's ten finals as a captain (all with Chennai) is the record outright.

records.title: Most matches as IPL captain
records.context: Across Chennai Super Kings (2008–15, 2018–23, 2025) and Rising Pune Supergiant (2016). Next is Rohit Sharma.

records.title: Fastest stumping recorded in international cricket
records.context: Stumping Keemo Paul off Kuldeep Yadav, India v West Indies, Thiruvananthapuram, 1 November 2018, as timed by the broadcaster.

records.title: Highest ODI score by an Indian wicketkeeper (at the time)
records.context: v Pakistan, Visakhapatnam, 5 April 2005, in his fifth ODI, batting at No.3.

records.title: Only international wicket
records.context: Travis Dowlin, caught at the Champions Trophy v West Indies, Johannesburg, 30 September 2009. His only wicket in 538 internationals. In the IPL he has never bowled.

records.title: Most wins in ICC ODI tournaments as captain
records.context: India went unbeaten through the 2013 Champions Trophy and won seven of seven group matches at the 2015 World Cup.

records.title: First Indian captain to whitewash Australia in a Test series
records.context: Chennai, Hyderabad, Mohali, Delhi, February–March 2013.

records.title: ODI Player of the Year
records.context: First player to win the ICC ODI Player of the Year in consecutive years.

milestones.title: First match as India captain
milestones.detail: World T20 v Scotland, Durban (abandoned); first completed match v Pakistan, won in a bowl-out

milestones.title: First Test as captain
milestones.detail: v South Africa, Kanpur — won by 8 wickets

milestones.title: Player of the match in a World Cup final
Last T20I as captain
milestones.detail: World T20 semi-final v West Indies, Mumbai

milestones.title: Last ODI as captain
milestones.detail: v New Zealand, Visakhapatnam — won series 3–2

milestones.title: Last ODI and last international
milestones.detail: World Cup semi-final v New Zealand, Manchester — 50, run out
